onlineChannels.title: Online channels
onlineChannels.subtitle: Own website and marketplaces · orders, payouts, fees and profit for each channel and each company
onlineChannels.notConnected: No store is connected yet. Orders will arrive automatically once the store connection (Phase 8) is set up; until then an order can be entered here and becomes a sales order.
onlineChannels.noChannelsBody: Admin sets up each channel with its GSTIN, the marketplace's buyer account and the stock place.

f.stateHelp: Two digits, e.g. 32 for Kerala. It decides the place of supply.
f.priceHelp: The price the buyer paid, including GST. The server works out the rate before tax.

onlineChannels.setupRule: The marketplace is a buyer account in your books: each order adds to what it owes you, and each payout clears it.
onlineChannels.noCreate: You do not have the right to take orders.
onlineChannels.ingested: Order brought in as sales order {{no}}.
onlineChannels.duplicate: This channel order was already brought in; nothing changed.
onlineChannels.booksTitle: From a marketplace order to the money in your bank

value.books: Sale invoice in your name and GSTIN; output GST on it

feeGst.books: Input GST credit, from the channel's monthly tax invoice

tcs.books: TCS receivable; credited to your GST cash ledger once the channel files it

returns.books: Credit note against the sale; returned stock back in after checking

payout.books: Matched to the bank credit; clears the channel's balance

onlineChannels.booksNote: TCS and TDS rates are not set in the app; the CA confirms them before settlements are posted.
onlineChannels.profitEmpty: Fills from settlements and ad invoices
onlineChannels.profitBody: Settlement reports and ad invoices arrive with the store connection in Phase 8; nothing is shown until then.
